title: Knowledge service (OKS)
description: Turns the knowledge service and data file declared by the session's workspace into five native tools (search / references / info / check_intent / query): find a key by name or description, walk the reference graph backwards from a key, read a node by key, validate a business question into structured intents, then answer it with real rows over a read-only connection. No model is baked in — a workspace opts in with an oks.json, and the agent explores the domain starting from the opaque key "index". Three helpers ride along: time_now / time_calc for standard time representations and calendar arithmetic, and va_ask, which consults a vocabulary helper the plugin owns (a top-level agent on the same preset and workspace, sharing the process-wide index, archived while idle): it prepares that helper itself (one prompt holding role, the whole vocabulary and the working method, and that prompt is the rewind marker) and, after every answer, collapses the question-and-answer after the marker — so between questions the helper sees only vocabulary, method and the current question, while the session log stays append-only. The plugin writes nothing into the workspace.
